data.content:
Now let me fix the three issues in `Directory.Build.targets`:

**1. Missing file guard** — `Import` of `custom-analyzers.props` will fail on fresh clones if the file doesn't exist.

**2. Hook property overwrite** — Setting `CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` overwrites any value a NuGet package already set, silently dropping its hook.

**3. Non-extensible code gen target** — Other teams can't plug in pre/post processing around `RunCodeGen`.

arguments.new_str:
<!-- Import shared analyzer configuration (guarded so fresh clones without the file don't break) -->
  <Import Project="$(RepoRoot)eng\custom-analyzers.props" Condition="Exists('$(RepoRoot)eng\custom-analyzers.props')" />

arguments.old_str:
<!-- Run code generation before compilation -->
  <Target Name="RunCodeGen" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
    <Exec Command="codegen.exe --output $(IntermediateOutputPath)generated.cs" />
  </Target>
arguments.new_str:
<!-- Extensibility points: other projects/packages can hook BeforeRunCodeGen / AfterRunCodeGen -->
  <Target Name="BeforeRunCodeGen" BeforeTargets="RunCodeGen" />
  <Target Name="RunCodeGen" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile" DependsOnTargets="BeforeRunCodeGen">
    <Exec Command="codegen.exe --output $(IntermediateOutputPath)generated.cs" />
  </Target>
  <Target Name="AfterRunCodeGen" AfterTargets="RunCodeGen" />

data.content:
Here's what was wrong and what I fixed:

### 1. Import fails on fresh clones
The `Import` of `eng\custom-analyzers.props` had no existence guard, so builds break when the file is missing. **Fix:** Added `Condition="Exists('...')"`.

### 2. NuGet hook silently dropped
Setting `CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` to a hard-coded path **overwrites** any value a NuGet package (like `MyAnalyzer.BuildTasks`) already set. **Fix:** Changed to `$(CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets);...` to **append** and preserve existing hooks.

### 3. Code gen target not extensible
`RunCodeGen` was a monolithic target with no way for other teams to inject pre/post processing. **Fix:** Added empty `BeforeRunCodeGen` and `AfterRunCodeGen` sentinel targets that other projects can override or hook into with their own `BeforeTargets`/`AfterTargets` or `DependsOnTargets`.
